summary: Implemented orchestrator/dev_supervisor (evidence.py, telemetry.py): Evidence model with OBSERVED/REPORTED/INFERRED/UNAVAILABLE labels and staleness; session-file reader with injectable pid probe; tail-read context pressure (last assistant usage record, configurable window table and warn/compact/replace thresholds, unknown model gives UNAVAILABLE); pluggable account-usage provider interface plus statusline JSON ingestor (no source gives UNAVAILABLE with reason); snapshot() returning a JSON-serialisable dict. IMPLEMENTED and TESTED offline (90 synthetic tests pass). OBSERVED once on the real machine (numbers only, see commands): 2 live sessions read, 1 pressure computed, 1 UNAVAILABLE because the model id is not in the default window table. NOT TESTED: statusline ingestor against a real Claude Code statusline payload (shape of rate_limits is an assumption, PROPOSED); account usage is UNAVAILABLE, no known source. Default context windows and thresholds are configuration defaults, not verified facts about any account.

commands.command: cd orchestrator && python -B -I -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_dev_telemetry.py

commands.result: OBSERVED: 2 sessions, both busy/alive/stale=True (status not updated within 300 s); session A: 360387 tokens, model claude-opus-5-5 not in default window table, pressure UNAVAILABLE; session B: 184076 tokens, model claude-sonnet-5-5, ratio 0.9204 against configured 200000 window, level replace; account_usage UNAVAILABLE (no provider)

unresolved: Real window sizes per model (e.g. whether claude-sonnet-5-5 or claude-opus-5-5 have larger windows) are not known to this lane; the table is configurable and the pressure for sonnet-5-5 (0.9204) depends on the assumed 200000 default. Needs a decision/source.
No account-usage/reset-window source is known; StatuslineProvider expects an assumed rate_limits shape that is NOT TESTED against a real statusline payload.
Stale=True for live busy sessions suggests statusUpdatedAt may not refresh while busy; default stale_after_seconds=300 may need tuning by the supervisor lane.
